name: debuff
description: Make 2D browser games with Codex: start from a platformer, side-scroller, top-down, isometric or point-and-click template in a minute, then Codex plays it, sees it, tunes the feel, tests and fuzzes it, explains stutter and makes pixel art and music while you make the creative calls.

interface.shortDescription: Make 2D browser games and let Codex play, tune and test them
interface.longDescription: Make 2D browser games with debuff, an open-source TypeScript framework. Codex starts a playable platformer, side-scroller, top-down, isometric or point-and-click game in a minute, then plays it headless or in the tab you have open, takes captures, reads live state, tunes feel params, runs scenario tests, fuzzes it, explains stutter and reads runtime errors that say whose problem they are. It can also make pixel art and music. You keep the creative calls.
defaultPrompt: Make me a small pixel-art platformer I can play in the browser
